test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In order to encourage more young voters to take part in the political process, Government of India has decided to celebrate ________ as "National Voters Day".
solution:
The correct answer is **25th January**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Voters Day** is celebrated on **25th January** every year in India.
 
• This day marks the foundation of the **Election Commission of India** in 1950.
 
• The celebration aims to encourage more young voters to participate in the **political process**.
 
• Various awareness programs and activities are organized to educate citizens about the importance of **voting**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Key Term
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Election Commission of India**
 An autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering election processes in India at the national and state levels.
 
 

 **Voter Awareness**
 Efforts made to educate citizens about their rights and responsibilities as voters, including the importance of voting and how to register to vote.
 
 

 **Electoral Roll**
 A list of all eligible voters who are registered to vote in a particular constituency.
 
 

 **Democracy**
 A system of government where the citizens exercise power by voting.
 
 

 **Voter ID Card**
 An identification card issued by the Election Commission of India to eligible voters, which allows them to vote in elections.
